item.title: Another Bihar shocker: After Jamui, Banka, minors abused, assaulted near Gaya hill
item.description: Two minors were allegedly assaulted by youths in Mahuadih village near Sherghati police station on Monday. Following the incident, arrests were made after a video surfaced on social media, prompting police investigation. The victims were reportedly stopped, abused, and held at the location while their motorcycle was vandalized. Authorities are working to identify additional suspects involved in the incident.

item.title: Google CEO 'agrees' that tech firms need to innovate responsibly
item.description: In a pivotal move towards responsible AI governance, Google CEO Sundar Pichai, alongside other tech leaders and the US President, endorsed the White House Accord on Super Intelligence. This initiative seeks to promote the safe advancement and implementation of cutting-edge AI technologies. Companies are urged to establish internal protocols and involve external auditors for accountability.

item.title: Son claims share in mother’s house, cites Rs 2.1L given; couple ordered to vacate
item.description: The case involved a son who continued living in his mother's house after his marriage despite having no independent title over the property. His mother, meanwhile, relied on a General Power of Attorney (GPA), an Agreement to Sale and a Will as documents establishing her ownership of the house.

item.title: Apple Pay launches in India: How to set it up and where you can use it
item.description: Apple has officially launched Apple Pay in India, allowing users with Axis Bank credit cards to make payments. The payment system provides a secure method for transactions in stores, apps, and online. Users can set up Apple Pay easily via the Axis Bank app or Wallet app on their devices. Many merchants are already accepting Apple Pay, with more expected to follow.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: Ashwin picks Sachin over Kohli, reveals what Virat must do to be on the same level
item.description: Ravichandran Ashwin weighed in on the ongoing debate between Tendulkar and Kohli concerning batting excellence. He argues that Tendulkar's standing is elevated due to the challenges prevalent in his playing days. While he appreciates Kohli's remarkable achievements and consistency, Ashwin notes the inherent difficulties in comparing legends from different eras.

item.title: Buddha statue bought for just over SEK 20 sells for SEK 2.44 million
item.description: A small Buddha statue purchased for over SEK 20 at a Uppsala flea market turned out to be a rare artifact from the Ming dynasty's Yongle period. After resting in obscurity for years, it astonishingly sold for SEK 2,437,500 at auction. This remarkable sale captivated attention worldwide, showcasing the valuable insights into art history that can emerge from seemingly insignificant finds.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: Mark Zuckerberg, Priscilla Chan donate $4 million to save 600-year-old Hawaii fishpond
item.description: Mark Zuckerberg and Priscilla Chan have contributed $4 million for the preservation of Alakoko Fishpond in Hawaii. This historic site, which is over 600 years old, faced potential environmental degradation and development pressure. The donation helped acquire the property for long-term stewardship by the nonprofit Mālama Hulē‘ia. Their initiative supports education about traditional Hawaiian aquaculture and native ecosystems.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: Taylor Swift’s former Beverly Hills home where she wrote ‘1989’ lists for $7.9m
item.description: Taylor Swift’s former Beverly Hills estate, where she wrote her hit album 1989, is back on the market for $7.995 million. The 1.5-acre Pillsbury Estate features a main residence, guest house, four bedrooms, five bathrooms, mature oak trees, a pickleball court and an eight-car motor court following extensive renovations by its current owners.

item.title: Shiv Sena (UBT) neta shot dead outside party office in Thane
item.description: Pradeep Purnekar, a functionary of Shiv Sena (UBT), was shot outside his party office on Tuesday night. He sustained serious injuries and was taken to a private hospital where he was pronounced dead. This incident occurred in a residential area, raising concerns over law and order in the locality. Police are investigating the incident and reviewing CCTV footage to identify the assailants.

item.title: Main accused in Begusarai hotel assault and rape case arrested by SIT
item.description: In Begusarai, the police successfully apprehended Rohit Kumar Sahni, the primary suspect in a disturbing rape case. During the process, he attempted to escape and sustained injuries. Following a woman's complaint, an FIR was filed, and she underwent a medical examination shortly after the incident, which took place at a hotel. Ongoing investigations involve securing the hotel room and an FSL team.

item.title: Hyderabad bank executive found dead in OYO room; lover fled at 3.30am
item.description: A 34-year-old woman was discovered dead in a hotel room in SR Nagar after her male companion left. Police suspect a late-night quarrel led to her fatal assault by the man identified as A Srinivas. Sirisha, a bank executive, had been in a relationship with Srinivas, who allegedly used a fake identity. Hotel staff alerted authorities after receiving no response from her room.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: Woman filmed while bathing; blackmailed and sexually assaulted for 6 months in Bihar
item.description: In a disturbing incident from Banka district, a woman has revealed that she was secretly filmed while bathing. Two men then exploited these recordings to blackmail and sexually assault her for several months. Seeking justice after this harrowing experience, she approached the police to file a formal complaint. Authorities have initiated an investigation and are gathering forensic evidence to validate her claims, while also working to arrest the perpetrators involved.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: Subsidies for homebuyers, bank lending & more: China's roadmap to boost property sectors
item.description: China is rolling out new economic initiatives to revitalize its struggling property sector. The central bank has slashed interest rates on its lending facility, promoting targeted bank loans. Furthermore, first-time buyers can benefit from mortgage interest subsidies on eligible properties. These measures aim to boost housing demand, especially in lower-tier cities experiencing economic challenges. Experts predict these policies will foster recovery in the affected sectors.
item.dc:creator: PRANJAL PANDEY

item.title: Railway cancelled train but withheld return fare; commission orders Rs 23,350 payout
item.description: In a recent ruling, the Sonipat district consumer commission directed the Railway Board to refund Rs 7,350 to a passenger. The reimbursement was due to a cancelled return ticket after railway services to Katra were suspended. The commission awarded additional compensation of Rs 5,000 for harassment and Rs 11,000 for legal expenses. The passenger had booked a journey affected by unforeseen circumstances, prompting the complaint.
item.dc:creator: SAURABH THAKUR

item.title: Inside Silicon Valley’s ‘whisper network’ warning women about 100+ alleged predators
item.description: A private list containing names of individuals accused of sexual misconduct is circulating among women in Silicon Valley. This document serves as an informal warning system for women navigating the tech ecosystem. Multiple women have shared experiences of sexual assault and reluctance to report due to career risks. Concerns are raised about the reliability of these allegations and the absence of accountability in handling complaints.
item.dc:creator: PRISHA PATNAIK

item.title: Walking a tightrope: 5 hurdles facing Noel Tata and an unlisted Tata Sons
item.description: Noel Tata's plan for merging Tata companies seeks to maintain the private status of Tata Sons, avoiding any public listing. However, the Reserve Bank of India has already rejected previous requests to ease regulatory restrictions on Tata Sons. Additionally, potential dissent within the Tata Sons board may question the validity of this merger initiative, amplified by the Shapoorji Pallonji Group's counterarguments.
item.dc:creator: REEBA ZACHARIAH

item.title: Mumbai man’s family preserves body in freezer for 4 years, police stunned
item.description: In a shocking revelation, Mumbai police found the preserved body of an elderly man in a clinic's freezer, following a tip-off. The family had chosen to keep the body for cryonics without notifying the authorities or the clinic. Authorities are now investigating the implications of such preservation methods under Indian law.
item.dc:creator: NITASHA NATU

item.title: From days without food to CWG gold: Ashmita faces India's 32-year judo wait at Asian Games
item.description: Ashmita Dey carries a remarkable journey into the 2026 Asian Games after becoming the first Indian judoka to win Commonwealth Games gold. From growing up amid food shortages and a pawned gold earring to losing her father before the CWG, Dey has fought through financial hardship, injury and grief. Now a DSP in the Uttar Pradesh Police, she faces a strong Asian field and India's 32-year wait for another judo medal.
item.dc:creator: VINEET RAMAKRISHNAN

item.title: Oil stays above $103 after Trump denies easing sanctions on Iran
item.description: Rising oil prices are reflecting a renewed uncertainty over US sanctions on Iran, with Brent crude surpassing $103 a barrel and WTI hovering around $89. As Qatar works hard to ease tensions between the United States and Iran, Saudi Arabia has resumed oil exports from the Red Sea, aiding recovery in regional supply.
item.dc:creator: SHIVANGHI PAYAL

item.title: Homebuyers, take note: These cities saw housing sales rise in Q3, here’s what changed
item.description: During the July to September quarter of 2026, residential housing sales in India revealed contrasting trends across major cities. While the Mumbai Metropolitan Region and Bengaluru reported a surge in transactions, Pune and Chennai faced notable declines. A total of 1,14,320 new residential units were introduced in seven cities, with average property prices climbing 7% annually. The approaching festive season is expected to boost the demand for residential properties.
item.dc:creator: SHIVANGHI PAYAL

item.title: ‘Bigger than internet’: Trump officially renames AI as ‘super intelligence’
item.description: US President Donald Trump has officially signed an executive order that replaces the term 'Artificial Intelligence' with 'Super Intelligence.' This shift mandates federal agencies to update their communications accordingly, showcasing the evolving technological landscape. At a White House gathering with tech executives, Trump emphasized this pivotal change, with a new legal definition expected to be proposed to Congress in the near future.
